headline: Meta launches Style Sketch AI app for virtually trying on clothes
summary: TechCrunch and Engadget both report Meta quietly launched an AI fashion app called Style Sketch for virtually trying on clothes. Engadget specifies the launch covers Indonesia, Singapore and Thailand, while TechCrunch describes the app building a virtual closet from Instagram photos or items added by photo, video or camera-roll upload.
